Inline comments: Review comments at @.github/workflows/cloudron-catalog-publish.yml: - Around line 7-12: Update the write-scoped publication jobs in this workflow to gate authorization directly on the event type, the main branch, and the publication variable; do not rely on outputs from pull request checks. Preserve the existing trigger behavior for pull_request, push, and workflow_dispatch while ensuring pull request-controlled checks cannot authorize publication. Review comments at @bin/orbit-offline: - Around line 14-17: Update the EXIT-trap handling in orbit-offline and orbit-setup-link so a failed supervisorctl restart produces a nonzero exit status. Preserve the CLI command’s original failure status, and keep restart failures distinguishable from setup-token failures in orbit-setup-link. - Line 26: Update the EXIT trap that calls start_orbit so it leaves Orbit stopped when the restore command fails, including an incomplete rollback. Preserve the existing restart behavior for successful restores and all other commands. Review comments at @start.sh: - Around line 75-79: Update the proxy-address fallback in the startup flow around detect_cloudron_proxy so it does not assume 172.18.0.1 when detection fails. Require an explicitly configured proxy address or stop startup with an error, and retain validation before nginx uses the address. - Around line 32-36: Update the key-generation flow around the `key_file` check to detect whether Orbit is an existing installation before generating a key. If the installation is initialized and the key is missing or empty, stop startup with an instruction to restore the original key; retain key generation for fresh installations. --- Failed pre-merge checks: - Docstring Coverage: Write docstrings for the functions missing them to satisfy the coverage threshold.
